creativeThesis: A mirror keeps reflecting; the eyes making the observation are changing what reaches awareness.
viewerExperience: Try mirror → recording later → rapid eye jump → same observer → retinal sweep → partial sensitivity dip → clear views mask blur → uninterrupted subjective view → playback timing → honest mirror payoff.
emotionalTarget: Personal surprise and satisfying understanding of how an ordinary view is maintained.
visualThesis: Stay with one illustrated person, mirror and iris; change viewpoint only when it reveals an otherwise hidden relationship.

decisions.treatment: Original layered cinematic vector portrait, animated eye macro, mirror perspective, qualitative retinal section and later-playback device.
decisions.rationale: Deterministic continuous eye position and explicit physical/perceptual labels preserve scientific timing.

decisions.treatment: Warm oxblood walls, softly lit copper skin, green-grey irises, silver mirror and quiet cream type. Large portrait and eye crops; sparse annotations over the scene.
decisions.rationale: Human-scale room makes an everyday experiment inviting. Irises carry identity through all views; no generic stock.

decisions.treatment: Local Kokoro af_heart speed1, exact measured sentence takes.
decisions.rationale: Established primary narrator; no new voice audition or brand departure.

decisions.treatment: Manrope600 54px, complete speech-first phrases, lower dark gradient, one or two lines.
decisions.rationale: Readable exact qualifiers; no per-word bouncing. Keep captions independent of optical/perceptual labels.

decisions.treatment: Original very quiet room tone and soft tactile shutter/replay cue, subtle airy transition into retinal view; no continuous music.
decisions.rationale: Sound marks recording versus later observation without falsely sonifying neural blackout.

decisions.treatment: Story-led35–50seconds: direct test, camera contrast, slowed mechanism and return to mirror.
decisions.rationale: Brief curiosity first; show one mechanism at a time and land the optical/perceptual distinction.

decisions.treatment: Look from one eye to the other in a mirror. Why can't you normally catch the movement?
decisions.rationale: Person and reflection visible immediately; ordinary-condition qualifier in narration.

decisions.treatment: 1080x1920 30fps; labels and captions within current provisional insets; all caption midpoints and selected movement checkpoints inspected.
decisions.rationale: Local phone-size approximation only. No real device/native UI claim, covers, variants or delivery packages.
